references.text: The Danites had previously taken Micah's carved image, ephod, household gods, and cast image, which led to the confrontation described in verse 22.
Micah's house had a shrine with an ephod and household gods, which the Danites now took with them as they left his territory.
Laban pursued Jacob in a similar way when he discovered that his household gods had been stolen, a parallel theme of pursuit after theft of religious objects.
The continuation of this confrontation shows how the Danites threatened Micah and his neighbors to give up the pursuit.
Abraham gathered his men and pursued the enemy to rescue Lot and his property, a similar theme of pursuit to recover what had been taken.
